thread:
maria_support: Hey team — Customer ACME Corp opened a ticket: AWS marketplace credits from accelerator program never landed in their Redwood account. They said the Marketplace order ID is `AMZ-ORD-00987` and AWS entitlement ARN `arn:aws:cm:123456789012:entitlement/accelerator/AMCE-ENT-78`. They shared a screenshot showing 0 credits in Billing UI. Can someone triage? :wave:
ryan_billing: Thanks Maria — I pulled the entitlement logs, looks like our webhook worker never processed the `EntitlementGranted` event for that ARN. No retry in our queue. Ticket ID 12234.
luis_ops: FYI I see a recent deploy of `marketplace-webhook` last night at 2023-11-02T03:12Z (deploy-bot reported success). Deploy logs show a timeout contacting AWS SQS for ~15s during that window. Might be transient.
devon_eng: Can we get the raw webhook payload from the customer timeframe? Maria, do you have the customer's timestamp for when they expected credits to land?
maria_support: They said they completed the marketplace flow on 2023-11-01 ~18:05 UTC. I asked for the confirmation email; they attached it with order id and a screenshot of the Marketplace console.
ryan_billing: I ran our entitlement lookup: `GET /v1/marketplace/entitlements?arn=arn:aws:cm:123456789012:entitlement/accelerator/AMCE-ENT-78` returned empty. So our system never recorded it.
devon_eng: Ok can ops re-run the SQS backlog job for that time window and dump messages? Use `sqstool drain --queue marketplace-entitlements --since 2023-11-01T17:50Z --until 2023-11-01T18:20Z` and paste any messages.
luis_ops: Running now. One message matched order `AMZ-ORD-00987`. Payload looks like this:
```json
{
  "event":"EntitlementGranted",
  "order_id":"AMZ-ORD-00987",
  "arn":"arn:aws:cm:123456789012:entitlement/accelerator/AMCE-ENT-78",
  "account_external_id":"acct-ACME-prod",
  "credits": 1000
}
```
ryan_billing: Nice. Why didn't it process? Any error in the webhook worker logs?
luis_ops: The webhook worker logged `400 Bad Request` when posting to `/internal/marketplace/ingest`. Error was `unknown_account_external_id`. The payload's `account_external_id` is `acct-ACME-prod` but our mapping table expects `acct-acme-prod` (lowercase). Looks like normalization mismatch.
devon_eng: Oof. We recently tightened validation to reject mixed-case external IDs during the integration hardening PR #422. That validation returns 400 and the message is dropped (no DLQ).
maria_support: Customer says they used the marketplace buyer flow — they wouldn't control case. We need to surface credits ASAP. Can we do a manual reconcile?
devon_eng: Yes. I can run our entitlement reconcile tool to ingest that message and create the credit entry. Command I'll run: `entitlement-reconcile --source aws --order AMZ-ORD-00987 --arn arn:aws:cm:123456789012:entitlement/accelerator/AMCE-ENT-78 --external acct-ACME-prod`
luis_ops: Before you run, note that the mapping between `external_id` -> `account_id` is in `acct-mapping` DB. We should map `acct-ACME-prod` -> `acct-acme-prod` canonical. I'll add an alias row.
ryan_billing: Also need to confirm the customer hasn't already been credited in a partial attempt. Check billing ledger for duplicate pre-approval entries.
devon_eng: I ran `entitlement-reconcile` in dry-run first — it shows it would apply 1000 credits to Redwood account `acct-acme-prod` and create ledger item `ledg-7789`. Running for real now.
(deploy-bot): entitlement-reconcile: job 9a3f starting by devon_eng at 2023-11-02T12:01:08Z
devon_eng: Done. Tool returned success and ledger entry `ledg-7789` created. Customer account now shows +1000 credits.
maria_support: Confirmed with customer on call — they can see credits in the UI now. They're relieved. :tada: Thanks everyone.
ryan_billing: Root cause: strict case validation in webhook ingest + no DLQ for 400s. Action items: 1) Add a normalization step to marketplace ingest (lowercase external ids) — devon to PR. 2) Add DLQ/metric for dropped entitlement events — luis to ticket. 3) Backfill check for last 30 days for mixed-case external IDs and auto-reconcile — billing to run weekly backfill until fixed.
devon_eng: I'll open PR #480 to normalize and include a unit test for case variants. ETA EOD.
luis_ops: I'll create a PagerDuty alert if SQS posts to `/internal/marketplace/ingest` return 4xx more than 5 times in 10m. Also adding DLQ wiring to the queue.
ryan_billing: I'll schedule the 30-day backfill job and run it once the mapping alias is in place.
maria_support: Leaving a note on the customer's ticket that we applied credits and the fix is in progress. Follow-up scheduled in 3 days.
devon_eng: Quick repro for validation team: POST the webhook payload with `account_external_id` `acct-ACME-prod` -> should be accepted after PR. Sample curl:
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event":"EntitlementGranted","arn":"arn:aws:cm:...","order_id":"AMZ-ORD-00987","account_external_id":"acct-ACME-prod","credits":1000}' https://internal.redwood/api/marketplace/ingest
```
luis_ops: Tagging this for SOC review in case casing variation has security implications.
ryan_billing: Closing loop with the finance team to ensure ledger `ledg-7789` reconciles with accelerator program invoice.
maria_support: Thanks all — great cross-team response. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
